result.summary: PLAN-MVEALSO9 published: Bedford-Marcy & 1Av-Astor shuttle plan. The rider desk has the handoff.

trace.label: open incident
trace.cypher:
MATCH (i:Incident {status: 'open'})
RETURN i.id AS id, i.title AS title, i.report AS report, i.routes AS routes, i.stretch AS stretch,
i.closedEids AS closedEids, i.status AS status, i.openedMs AS openedMs
ORDER BY i.openedMs DESC LIMIT 1

trace.label: plans for the incident
trace.cypher:
MATCH (p:Plan)-[:FOR]->(i:Incident)
WHERE $incident = '' OR i.id = $incident
RETURN p.id AS id, p.label AS label, p.status AS status, p.legs AS legs, p.vehicles AS vehicles,
p.overflowBefore AS overflowBefore, p.overflowAfter AS overflowAfter, p.unmetBefore AS unmetBefore,
p.unmetAfter AS unmetAfter, p.strandedBefore AS strandedBefore, p.strandedAfter AS strandedAfter,
p.createdMs AS createdMs, p.publishedMs AS publishedMs, i.id AS incident
ORDER BY createdMs DESC LIMIT 12

trace.label: remove earlier shuttles
trace.cypher: MATCH ()-[b:BUS]->() DELETE b

trace.label: add the plan's shuttle legs
trace.cypher:
UNWIND $legs AS l
MATCH (a:Station {id: l.from}), (b:Station {id: l.to})
CREATE (a)-[:BUS {bid: l.bid, plan: $plan, capacity: l.capacity, spare: l.capacity, minutes: l.minutes, cost: l.minutes, busesPerHour: l.busesPerHour}]->(b),
(b)-[:BUS {bid: l.bid, plan: $plan, capacity: l.capacity, spare: l.capacity, minutes: l.minutes, cost: l.minutes, busesPerHour: l.busesPerHour}]->(a)

trace.label: what overflows with the plan running
trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Plan {id: $plan}) RETURN p.crowding AS crowding

trace.label: routing cost is travel time
trace.cypher: MATCH ()-[r:BOARD|ALIGHT|RIDE|WALK|BUS]->() SET r.cost = r.minutes, r.crowd = null

trace.label: crowded rides cost more
trace.cypher:
UNWIND $segs AS c
MATCH ()-[r:RIDE {eid: c.eid}]->()
SET r.crowd = c.pct, r.cost = r.minutes * c.factor
RETURN count(r) AS n

trace.label: publish and hand off to the rider desk
trace.cypher:
MATCH (p:Plan {id: $plan}), (c:Agent {id: 'controller'}), (r:Agent {id: 'rider-desk'})
SET p.status = 'published', p.publishedMs = timestamp(), p.approvedBy = $approvedBy
CREATE (c)-[:HANDED_OFF {atMs: timestamp(), incident: $incident, plan: $plan,
note: 'Plan published. Tell every remembered rider whose trip crosses the closure what to take instead.'}]->(r)

event.note: Plan published. Tell every remembered rider whose trip crosses the closure what to take instead.

trace.label: open incident
trace.cypher:
MATCH (i:Incident {status: 'open'})
RETURN i.id AS id, i.title AS title, i.report AS report, i.routes AS routes, i.stretch AS stretch,
i.closedEids AS closedEids, i.status AS status, i.openedMs AS openedMs
ORDER BY i.openedMs DESC LIMIT 1

trace.label: riders and what they prefer now
trace.cypher:
MATCH (r:Rider)-[:STARTS_AT]->(a:Station), (r)-[:ENDS_AT]->(b:Station)
OPTIONAL MATCH (r)-[p:PREFERS]->(pref:Preference)
WHERE p.validToMs IS NULL
WITH r, a, b, collect(CASE WHEN pref IS NULL THEN null ELSE {key: pref.key, value: pref.value, sinceMs: p.validFromMs} END) AS prefs
RETURN r.id AS id, r.name AS name, r.persona AS persona, r.departs AS departs, r.stepFree AS stepFree,
a.id AS from, b.id AS to, r.usualEids AS usualEids, r.usualStations AS usualStations,
r.usualMinutes AS usualMinutes, prefs AS preferences
ORDER BY name

trace.label: current accessibility outages (memory)
trace.cypher:
MATCH (f:Finding {kind: 'accessibility'})-[:ABOUT]->(s:Station)
WHERE f.validToMs IS NULL
OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[:ABOUT]->(r:Route)
RETURN s.id AS id, f.text AS text, f.validFromMs AS sinceMs, collect(r.id) AS routes

trace.label: rides over capacity right now
trace.cypher: MATCH ()-[r:RIDE]->() WHERE r.crowd > 100 RETURN count(r) AS n

trace.label: paths weighed by minutes and crowding
trace.cypher:
MATCH (a:Station {id: $from}), (b:Station {id: $to})
CALL algo.SPpaths({sourceNode: a, targetNode: b, relTypes: ['BOARD', 'RIDE', 'ALIGHT', 'WALK', 'BUS'], weightProp: 'cost', pathCount: $k})
YIELD path, pathWeight
RETURN [n IN nodes(path) | {station: coalesce(n.station, n.id), route: n.route, platform: hasLabels(n, ['Platform'])}] AS nodes,
[r IN relationships(path) | {t: type(r), eid: r.eid, minutes: r.minutes, crowd: r.crowd}] AS rels,
pathWeight AS weight
ORDER BY weight

trace.label: fastest paths, ignoring crowding
trace.cypher:

YIELD path, pathWeight
RETURN [n IN nodes(path) | {station: coalesce(n.station, n.id), route: n.route, platform: hasLabels(n, ['Platform'])}] AS nodes,
[r IN relationships(path) | {t: type(r), eid: r.eid, minutes: r.minutes, crowd: r.crowd}] AS rels,
pathWeight AS weight
ORDER BY weight
